title: Brand Standards Schedule: Walked-Stay Reduction for Free Night Awards
content:
The nights booked on a relocated reservation set a walked-stay reduction. For one of the Free Night Awards coming back from a reservation the hotel relocated, the walked-stay reduction reads the nights booked on the relocated reservation, as its Room Reservations record shows them. It is taken off the walked-night protected price once.

| Nights booked on the relocated reservation | Walked-stay reduction |
|---|---|
| 3 or more (upper walked-stay nights) | 5000 points (upper walked-stay reduction) |
| 2 (at least the lower walked-stay nights, fewer than the upper) | 2500 points (lower walked-stay reduction) |
| 1, a shorter stay | No walked-stay reduction |

At least the upper walked-stay nights earn the upper walked-stay reduction, at least the lower walked-stay nights the lower walked-stay reduction, and a shorter stay nothing. A hypothetical five-night relocated reservation therefore takes 5000 points, and a two-night one 2500 points.
